first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The broad gray paved road surface in the lower part of the main view, curving left and connecting to the passage beneath the Gray Concrete Structure.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: The long guardrail along the road edge, composed of multiple silver-gray parallel horizontal bars.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: The alternating red-and-white curb strip extending along the inner left-hand curve.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The Blue Sky outside and above the entrance, between the top of the slope and the edge of the concrete structure.

entities.name: Yellow-and-Black Arrow Barrier Wall
entities.identification: The continuous strip-like barrier wall with alternating yellow-and-black arrow-shaped patterns along the outer curve outside the entrance.

entities.name: Gray Concrete Structure
entities.identification: The low racetrack passage enclosed by a gray roof slab, vertical walls on both sides, and entrance supports.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The fixed on-screen overlay containing orange text, a horizontal rear-view frame at the top, a route map at the lower left, a circular gauge at the lower right, and green symbols.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The steep sloped terrain on the left side of the road and outside the entrance, elevated above the racetrack, excluding the vegetation on its surface.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The green vegetation areas on the grass inside the left-hand curve, on the outer slope by the entrance, and at the top of the slope.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The silver-white race car entering from the left edge of the top rear-view frame; in the later portion, its relatively wide, low front and part of its body are visible.
